label: Initial-history authenticity: exact admissibility, coalescence and essential-origin limits
summary: Bounded analyst investigation documented in docs/notes/fixed-initial-history-535.md#initial-conditions-and-authentic-historical-evidence-2026-11-24. Reused HistorySelection SameEvidence/EvidenceOnly, distinguished its presence-history Determines from complete state trajectories, and inspected UltimateExplanation, the #1904 historical-reliability note and open #1927 AdaptiveHistoryAccess without importing or duplicating its adaptive result. Four frozen certificates derive admitted variation preservation under injectivity, input recovery from complete trajectories, the exact positive-fiber condition for authentic records, and the essential-origin/identified-existing-bearer bridge with authentic anchors; concrete controls distinguish state coalescence, coarse observation, uniformly false fibers and genuine deterministic record correction. Rejected unconditional conservation of every output distinction: a many-to-one rule may fix a coarse state, or correct records by reading a retained past coordinate, while full trajectories remain different. Essential origin alone neither identifies the observed bearer nor makes its record true. All controls are structural surrogates and no fake-history metaphysical admissibility, unrestricted recombination, equal priors or guarantee-to-skepticism inference is asserted. Direct Lean elaboration and axiom inspection pass for all four targets with zero axioms; corpus generation/check and sense preflights pass. Comparator/NanoDa and independent final semantic challenge remain coordinator gates; these local checks are development evidence, not a certification claim. The first SafeInitial equivalence is explicitly definitional; the fiber witness factorization, EvidenceOnly adapter, time induction and omission/correction controls supply the substantive comparison. No root implication or premise discharge is claimed.
blocker: Application to historical evidence needs an independently interpreted historical-content relation, a complete state/memory description, and warrant for the admitted initial class or a truth-linked causal/identity restriction. A fallible knowledge claim separately needs a reliability/probability/normative bridge. Application to existence PSR 608a262d needs the same contingent bearer, its existence reason and the relevant explanatory standard; none is supplied by extensional initial variation or absence of one ultimate explanation. Next distinct test: instantiate one actual causal record channel and determine whether a false-content positive fiber is really admitted or excluded at that same scope.
